description: Closed-forecast record of ONE speaker or institution: counts of met, partial and not met, and a hit rate per register area. Pass speaker or institution (or both). Hit rates count only forecasts whose criterion was fixed before the outcome; retrospective (back-captured) entries are counted separately under retrospective. Uses public and MCP-only entries, never internal ones. To see forecasts by many sources on one topic use compare_forecasts. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

institution.description: Name of the institution or organisation to match (case- and accent-insensitive, partial match allowed; common abbreviations understood, for example SNB, Fed/FOMC, ECB/EZB, IMF, TTWO, NVDA). Alias: organisation. Examples: "IMF", "SNB", "OpenAI".

speaker.description: Name of the person or official speaker to match (case- and accent-insensitive; partial names, surnames and common short forms allowed). Examples: "Altman", "Powell", "Sam Altman".

name: track_record
